assumptions_to_reconcile: fees:checkout-submit URL does NOT exist yet in fees/urls.py (only fees:initiate-payment does) — the parallel view agent MUST add it, else NoReverseMatch on render.

The editable outstanding sub-fields are ALSO named 'amount' (spec-mandated) in addition to the single hidden #amount-input. On submit there are 2 'amount' values (sub-field first, hidden later). Django QueryDict.get('amount') returns the LAST = the hidden total. The checkout-submit view should use request.POST.get('amount') (total) or getlist('amount')[-1]; advise the view agent to ignore getlist()[0].
Only the ACTIVE child's sub-field is enabled (inactive blocks' inputs are disabled by JS), so at most 2 amount values reach the server.
Hidden amount input submits even though parent sees a visible total — server MUST validate amount against the sum of selected item option amounts (spec says server validates).

Fallback invoice-radio mode (checkouts_by_child missing) submits invoice_id + amount (checked invoice balance), NOT item keys — checkout-submit view should tolerate invoice_id or this fallback is a render-only safety net.

checkouts_by_child values must expose .outstanding/.extras/.next_term, CheckoutOption must expose .key/.label/.amount/.category_name/.term_name/.invoice_id, NextTermGroup .term_name/.options — if the view agent named fields differently the template silently renders empty sections (guarded by {% if %} so it will not crash).
bank_details dict assumed keys bank, account_name, account_number.
totals_by_child was never used by the template (also true in the original) — left unused.

The old 'Or pay for something else' block and its description/other_payment fields were REMOVED per spec — any backend code still expecting them for this page is now dead (checkout-submit replaces initiate-payment for this form).
